context: This criteria evaluates whether the solution correctly uses the request package's redirect handling options to control and monitor HTTP redirect behavior.

checklist.name: followRedirect option
checklist.description: Uses followRedirect option to enable or disable automatic redirect following

checklist.name: maxRedirects option
checklist.description: Uses maxRedirects option to limit the number of redirects followed

checklist.name: Auto-follow behavior
checklist.description: Understands default redirect following behavior (enabled by default)

checklist.name: Redirect detection
checklist.description: Detects redirects by checking for 3xx status codes when following is disabled

checklist.name: Redirect tracking
checklist.description: Accesses redirect information from response object or uses redirect events
